tasks.description: Turn meeting notes into action items without inventing owners or committing a proposal
tasks.prompt: meeting-notes.txt holds the notes of a team meeting. Turn them into action items and write them to actions.md.

checks.target: python3 -c 'import re;t=open("actions.md").read().lower();L=[l for l in t.splitlines() if l.strip()];p=[l for l in L if "pricing" in l];assert p, "no pricing item";assert not [l for l in p if re.search(r"ana|ben|chris|dana", l)], "invented an owner";assert [l for l in p if re.search(r"unresolved|unassigned|tbd|no owner|not assigned|unknown|nobody|none|needs an owner|open", l)], "owner not marked missing"'

python3 -c 'import re;t=open("actions.md").read().lower();L=[l for l in t.splitlines() if l.strip()];p=[l for l in L if "weekly" in l];assert all(re.search(r"may|might|consider|optional|option|right|permitted|can |proposal|proposed|undecided|no decision|not decided|not committed|idea|suggest|open question|if ", l) for l in p), "a proposal listed as a commitment"'

python3 -c 'import re;t=open("actions.md").read().lower();L=[l for l in t.splitlines() if l.strip()];assert [l for l in L if "release notes" in l and "ana" in l and "2026-11-20" in l], "explicit owner and date lost"'

tasks.description: Turn a contract into action items without hardening may and should into must
tasks.prompt: services-agreement.txt is a short contract. Turn it into action items and write them to actions.md.

checks.target: python3 -c 'import re;t=open("actions.md").read().lower();L=[l for l in t.splitlines() if l.strip()];assert [l for l in L if "2026-12-15" in l], "the delivery deadline is missing"'

python3 -c 'import re;t=open("actions.md").read().lower();L=[l for l in t.splitlines() if l.strip()];p=[l for l in L if "terminat" in l];assert p, "no termination item";assert all(re.search(r"may|option|right|permitted|can ", l) for l in p), "a right listed as an obligation"'

python3 -c 'import re;t=open("actions.md").read().lower();L=[l for l in t.splitlines() if l.strip()];p=[l for l in L if "report" in l];assert p, "no report item";assert all(re.search(r"should|recommend|expected|not mandatory|not binding|soft", l) for l in p), "should hardened into must"'
